description: Per-agent context controls: choose the token target where compaction activates and the exact recent amount kept verbatim. Unchanged prompt blocks are reused from bounded RAM/disk caches and provider prefix caches, while the app-wide 1.05M-token maximum remains a hard safety ceiling.
_tools_note: The three agent-facing tools are displayed under Core ▸ Base and remain always-on. This dual-surface descriptor exposes per-agent target/verbatim preferences under Knowledge while App Functions owns the global safety ceiling and advanced defaults. Do NOT re-add update_task_checkpoint / get_task_checkpoint here: those plan/task tools were relocated to the always-on core (app/tools/core_tools.py, wired by app/tools/loader.py under Core ▸ Base and locked on in TIER_1_ALWAYS_ON).
skill_summary: Your own context window: the fill gauge, one automatic rolling checkpoint for older conversation, a newest verbatim tail, and three tools — compact_context to deliberately checkpoint now, recall_compacted to read the ORIGINAL turns behind the checkpoint, and search_this_session to keyword-find details across the full conversation. Load this whenever the user asks about context or memory, before a long multi-phase task, or whenever a needed detail may have been compacted. NOTE: you CAN compact on demand; do not tell the user compaction is automatic-only.

levels.off: Do NOT call compact_context yourself — leave all compaction to the automatic background threshold.
levels.balanced: Reserve compact_context for a rare, deliberate fold only at a clean checkpoint of a long multi-step project, when early settled turns are taking room you need next.
levels.eager: On big multi-step work, proactively call compact_context at each phase boundary to reclaim room before the next phase (still never mid-phase).

settings.label: Self-Compaction Posture

options.label: Balanced — only at clean phase checkpoints
Eager — free room proactively between phases

settings.hint: How willing the agent is to run compact_context ITSELF (separate from automatic compaction).

settings.label: Historical Tool Evidence
settings.hint: Controls when historical tool inputs and outputs become compact retrieval receipts. User and assistant messages remain; the current run is always full. Quality compacts completed tasks, while Economy also bounds long tasks.

settings.label: Full-Evidence Runs
settings.hint: Total newest user-triggered runs kept with complete tool evidence, including the current run. Internal manager, scout, closer, and resume iterations do not create runs.

settings.label: Full Tool-Evidence Token Budget
settings.hint: Approximate budget for complete tool arguments and results in the active task. Whole newest runs are retained until the budget is reached; the current run is never reduced.

settings.label: Auto-Detect Window From Model
settings.hint: Use the active model's published context window, capped by the app-wide maximum below.

settings.label: Maximum Context Tokens
settings.hint: App-wide hard ceiling for every agent. Auto-detected model windows and per-agent compaction targets can be smaller, never larger.

settings.label: Compaction Target Tokens
settings.hint: Absolute assembled-context size where compaction activates. For example, 100K starts folding old turns once the live context reaches about 100,000 tokens.

settings.label: Keep Verbatim Tokens
settings.hint: Absolute number of newest tokens kept word-for-word after compaction. This is clamped below the effective target at runtime.

settings.label: Rolling Checkpoint Size (fraction of target)
settings.hint: Maximum output size for the one rolling checkpoint, as a fraction of the compaction target.

settings.label: Summary Model (optional)
settings.hint: Optional model id used only to write compacted summaries. Leave blank to reuse the configured chat model.
